title: Bonny Oaks: opening and closing
purpose: Opening and closing at Bonny Oaks: different float and deposit route from East Main.
facts: Deposit bag goes into the drop safe under the counter; slot 9 carries it to East Main on the 13:00 run next working day and signs the bag log; slot 3 banks it.
Saturday messages for Bonny Oaks are on East Main's list.
Bays and side lot are left clear on Friday night for A2's five vans on Monday.

list_items.item: Key drop box, to the left of the door. Envelopes into orders.
Voicemail, then the missed-call list. Saturday's messages for us are on East Main's list; ask them on Monday morning if nothing came across.
Cars in or locked. Keys in the cabinet.
Close the till: Closing the till. $150 stays in the drawer.

The deposit bag goes in the drop safe under the counter. We have no office here. Marcus takes it to East Main on his 1:00 run the next working day and Donna banks it with theirs. He signs the bag log when he takes it.

new_facts: Float 150 USD at Bonny Oaks; drop safe; the bag travels on the parts run. The ERP till closes for east use a 150 float.
